newsitem.title: UK: Waddington sees stg hitting annual profits.
newsitem.headline: Waddington sees stg hitting annual profits.

text.p: British specialist printing and board manufacturing group Waddington Plc on Friday estimated the continued strength of sterling would knock around 1.0 million stg off its operating profit this year.
"At the time of our results announcement in June we had factored the higher value of the pound into our budgets for the coming year," chairman David Perry told the annual general meeting.
"Since that time sterling has appreciated further".
As announced in February, Perry is retiring after today's AGM. His replacement is Michael Orr.
